tools.name: list_ledgers
tools.description:
List all ledgers for the authenticated BeeCount user.

    Returns each ledger's id (external_id), name, currency, and created_at.
    Use the returned id when calling other tools that take ledger_id.

tools.name: get_active_ledger
tools.description:
Get the user's primary/default ledger.

    Use this when the user doesn't specify which ledger they're talking about.
    Returns null if the user has no ledgers.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description:
Query transactions with rich filters.

    Args:
        ledger_id: Optional. If omitted, uses the active ledger.
        date_from, date_to: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO datetimes.
        category: Exact category name match.
        account: Exact account name match (matches account/from_account/to_account).
        min_amount, max_amount: Filter by absolute amount.
        q: Substring match against note.
        limit: Max items returned (1..200, default 50).

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get a single transaction by its sync_id (cross-ledger lookup).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List user's categories. kind is one of: expense, income, transfer.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List user's accounts. account_type filters by type (bank_card, credit_card, cash, ...).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all of the user's tags.

tools.name: list_budgets
tools.description: List budgets for a ledger with current-month spent/remaining/percent_used.

tools.name: get_ledger_stats
tools.description: Get summary stats for a ledger (transaction/category/account/tag/budget counts).

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description:
Income/expense/balance plus top-10 spending categories.

    Args:
        scope: 'month' | 'year' | 'all'.
        period: For month: 'YYYY-MM'. For year: 'YYYY'. Defaults to current.
        ledger_id: Optional, uses active ledger if omitted.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text fuzzy search across transaction notes, category names, account names.

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description:
Upload a receipt/file to a ledger and return its file_id and SHA256.

    The client reads the user's local file and sends standard Base64 bytes
    (without a data URL prefix). A remote Cloud cannot read client file paths.
    Prefer small receipt images; the configured attachment upload size limit
    applies. Same bytes in the same ledger reuse the existing file_id.
    If multiple ledgers exist, supply ledger_id. Uploading does not create a
    transaction: pass the returned file_id to create/update_transaction's
    ordered attachments list, using the same ledger.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create one expense, income or complete transfer. Supply both from/to accounts for transfers. Prefer stable IDs. Use the same idempotency_key on retries; original times and exchange-rate snapshots are retained. native_amount is the actual settlement in ledger currency. Offset-free timestamps follow Cloud timezone; never append Z to local time. Upload attachments first, then pass ordered file IDs. Multiple ledgers require an explicit ledger_id.

tools.name: create_transactions
tools.description: Create 1..200 transactions with a durable operation ID and per-step results. Use a stable idempotency_key to retry without duplicates. Each group of at most 50 commits independently; partial failures retain completed groups. Query get_operation and retry_operation to resume. Supports complete transfers, stable dictionary IDs, currency/settlement snapshots, flags and ordered attachment IDs. Preserve source UTC offsets.

amount.description: Positive finite amount; numeric strings are accepted
amount.title: Amount

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Update only supplied transaction fields. Use expected_revision from get_transaction to reject conflicting changes. Complete transfers require both accounts; use ledger_id if sync_id is ambiguous. Omitted/null attachments preserve files; [] clears; an ordered file ID list replaces. Amount corrections preserve the recorded settlement ratio unless native_amount/currency is explicitly supplied.

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Delete a transaction only after explicit user confirmation (confirm=true). Optional expected_revision protects concurrent edits. Specify ledger_id when sync_id is ambiguous.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a new category. Usually unnecessary — prefer existing categories.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: Update a budget's amount.

tools.name: parse_and_create_from_text
tools.description:
Have BeeCount AI parse free-form natural-language text into a transaction.

    Useful when the user gives a sentence like "上午星巴克花了 38" and you want
    BeeCount's own AI prompt + ledger context to do the heavy lifting. Requires
    the user to have configured an AI chat provider in their profile.

tools.name: get_bookkeeping_context
tools.description: Get ledger selection, role, server time/timezone, currency, dictionary IDs and feature contracts in one call. No ledger is guessed when several exist.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Read durable per-step outcomes and exact transaction boundaries after a timeout or partial failure.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: Find recent operations, including an operation whose initial response was lost.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Read incremental transaction/budget and dictionary changes including deletion tombstones. Keep the signed next_cursor even when has_more=false.

tools.name: get_account_balances
tools.description: Get opening balance, income, expense, transfers and calculated balance per account/currency. at is an exclusive timestamp or an inclusive local date. No currencies are added together.

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Read monthly assets/debts/net worth in original currencies. Optional primary-currency valuation is returned only when all conversion rates exist; current valuation rates are explicitly distinguished from historical FX returns.

tools.name: list_ledger_members
tools.description: List members and roles of a ledger accessible to this token's user.

tools.name: manage_account
tools.description: Create/edit/archive (hidden=true)/delete an account. Owner role required. Balance edits change opening balance; preview impact with reconcile_account. Delete requires confirm=true.

tools.name: manage_category
tools.description: Create/rename/reparent/delete a category using stable IDs. Owner role required; deleting a referenced category follows the production validation rules.

tools.name: manage_tag
tools.description: Create/rename/recolor/delete a tag. Existing transaction relationships use stable IDs. Owner role required; deletion requires confirmation.

tools.name: manage_budget
tools.description: Create/edit/enable/disable/delete total or category budgets. Usage follows the ledger billing cycle, child categories and exclude_from_budget flags.

tools.name: manage_ledger
tools.description: Create/rename/configure/delete a ledger. Deletion requires confirm=true. For create, supply ledger_name and a caller-chosen ledger_id to make retries stable.

tools.name: retry_operation
tools.description: Resume only unfinished steps using the original normalized times, currencies and stable idempotency keys. A live concurrent lease returns running.

tools.name: analyze_transactions
tools.description: Aggregate matching transactions by local calendar/category/account/tag/member with optional comparison filters and exact drill-down context. Income/expense use ledger settlement currency; transfers are separate and never counted as consumption. Multi-tag groups overlap.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read an original receipt image or small text attachment after checking current ledger membership. Large/binary files return an authenticated MCP resource link; bytes are never resized or transcoded.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: Find receipt files and their linked transactions, with filename/note search and pagination.

tools.name: export_transactions
tools.description: Create a complete CSV snapshot (up to 50000 rows) with IDs, original/settlement currencies and flags. Fetch the saved CSV using its authenticated MCP resource URI.

tools.name: parse_receipt
tools.description: Use the user's configured BeeCount vision provider to recognize an uploaded receipt into drafts. No transaction is created. Keep file_id as the attachment when creating approved drafts.

tools.name: preview_text_transactions
tools.description: Ask the user's configured BeeCount text provider for drafts without recording transactions. Review drafts, then call create_transaction(s) with a stable idempotency key.

tools.name: preview_import_file
tools.description: Parse an uploaded CSV/TSV/XLSX with the production parser, return mappings/errors and save a durable import preview. Each plan covers at most 200 source rows; use next_offset for large files. No transaction is written.

tools.name: save_review_item
tools.description: Save a question, related transaction IDs, user answer and resolution state so another Agent can continue. Updates require the current revision.

tools.name: save_classification_rule
tools.description: Save a versioned categorization rule and exceptions. Confirmed rules require explicit user confirmation; inferred rules remain suggestions and are never applied automatically.

tools.name: apply_classification_rule
tools.description: Save a preview of a confirmed rule's matching transactions and before/after values. Apply using execute_classification_preview; each target carries its original revision.

tools.name: execute_classification_preview
tools.description: Apply exactly the saved rule preview after user confirmation. Stale transaction revisions fail without overwriting user edits.

tools.name: manage_recurring_rule
tools.description: Preview/create/edit/pause/resume/delete a Cloud-owned recurring rule. Month/year ends clamp to valid dates without drifting the anchor. Historical backfill is opt-in; generated ordinary transactions sync to App. Do not duplicate the same rule in App.

amount.description: Positive finite amount; numeric strings are accepted
amount.title: Amount

tools.name: run_due_recurring_rules
tools.description: Process currently due Cloud schedules owned by this user in one ledger. Never generates future transactions; repeated runs are idempotent.

tools.name: list_workflow_records
tools.description: Read persistent workflow progress across computers/Agents. Results are ledger scoped and include optimistic revisions; paginate with offset.

tools.name: get_workflow_record
tools.description: Read a saved import/reconciliation/rule/review record by ID, after checking current ledger membership.

tools.name: list_transaction_sources
tools.description: Read all source identities proving a transaction, including source-file hashes/row numbers.

tools.name: reconcile_account
tools.description: Compare an actual statement balance with opening balance plus all accessible account movements through a date/time. Report missing-account candidates; never silently create adjustments.

tools.name: link_transaction_source
tools.description: Attach another source receipt/order/bank entry to an existing transaction. A source identity can refer to only one transaction within a ledger.

tools.name: unlink_transaction_source
tools.description: Remove an incorrect external-source association after user confirmation. The transaction is preserved; reserved active-import sources cannot be removed.

tools.name: preview_import
tools.description: Persist a versioned dry-run of 1..200 imports. Exact source IDs identify existing entries; same-day/same-amount matches are only review candidates. No transactions are written.

amount.description: Positive finite amount; numeric strings are accepted
amount.title: Amount

tools.name: execute_import_plan
tools.description: Execute the exact saved import preview after user confirmation. Restart/response-loss retries reuse the original operation; source links are persisted idempotently.

tools.name: undo_import_plan
tools.description: Remove only transactions created by an import. Revision checks preserve later user edits; linked pre-existing entries are never removed. Confirmation required.

tools.name: save_reconciliation_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a user-confirmed account/source coverage checkpoint, including the statement difference and dataset revision, for another Agent to continue.
